title: Tryptophan

source.dataset: psychonautwiki_db.zip (psychonautwiki.db, SQLite export provided by Hany, file dated 2026-11-25)

plain_text: Tryptophan (Trp or W) is an α-aminoacid used in biosynthesis of proteins. It contains an α-amino group, an  α-carboxylic acid group and a side chain indole, making it a polar molecule with non-polar aromatic beta carbon substituent. Trp is a precursor for serotonin, melatonin and vitamin B3. It is encoded by the codon UGG.
wikitext: '''Tryptophan''' ('''Trp''' or '''W''') is an α-aminoacid used in biosynthesis of proteins. It contains an α-amino group, an  α-carboxylic acid group and a side chain [https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indole indole], making it a polar molecule with non-polar aromatic beta carbon substituent. '''Trp''' is a precursor for [[serotonin]], [[melatonin]] and vitamin B3. It is encoded by the codon UGG.
